We have seen issues with this charger sometimes now.
The state of DC1 is not correct. The charger thinks a car is pluged in, however this is not the case.
After a reboot of the charger it can work without any issues for 2-4 days, the we will see the issue again.
The charger has this issue right now. So if you quickly can have a look then I will not reboot the charger.

additional_info.subject: ID0433005-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S1 170003245] Charger Malfunctioning CRM:02888000102
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus, good morning.
It seems from the logs that we are seeing PilotState B2, if you are saying that there is no car connected, we need to understand where the fault lies.
We need to measure in the cable, the input to StateMonitor and EcoG for the CP signal to ground.
I recommend you to take a spare CCS, KF12 and KF14, in order to avoid another site visit.
If the cable measures 9V then we have a problem with the cable
If you measure 12V in the cable, then go to KF12 and KF14 and see where it drops to 9V.
If you still see 12V at the input of both controllers, please try a different spare grey connector from EcoG or StateMonitor
If you still see the error, please replace the StateMonitor or EcoG and see which one fixes it.
If you need support reach out me via Teams, I will send this ticket back to you.
Best regards,
Francisco
